descriptor.verify: Recompile saleshard_prod5 with (protocolFeeScript, creator, token, base, slope, feeBps 100, curveSupply 650, sold 0, feesOwed 0, vaultOwed 0, poolTokenReserve 350000000, poolIdx 0): output 0 must pay to that script hash, and output 1 must be the full supply as a KCC-20 output owned by the curve's covenant id (owner scheme 0x04) under covenant id `token`. KForge lists only tokens whose base and slope equal the parameters above.
